categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P, touches src/net.cpp listener socket configuration for P2P connections.
categories.rationale: Prevents local port hijacking on Windows where another process under the same user could bind and intercept incoming P2P connections. Per the description citing Microsoft Winsock documentation, SO_REUSEADDR allows a second socket to steal incoming connections unless SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE is explicitly set.
